gen-gf-coiny-fs-rowan: Coiny spaces its letters extra wide and pinches its bowls nearly shut, with barely any stroke variation. Rowan, friendly and literary, opens every curve generously, which fits brief bursts of text better than page after page.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-recia: Friendly, casual letters from Comic Neue run at hairline thickness, with open c forms that never close into rings. Comic Neue charms; Recia commands, gently narrowing, best taken in modest helpings.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-synonym: A rope-thin outline with no swelling anywhere gives Comic Neue its casual, handwritten feel, and its c forms stay open. Comic Neue charms while Synonym steadies, comfortable across brief stretches.
gen-gf-comic-neue-outfit: Comic Neue writes like a relaxed hand, its open, rope-thin strokes friendly and casual. Outfit brings clean, approachable curves that stop short of closing, good for a quick note.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-epunda-slab: Commanding letters with no stroke variation, bowls left open on one side. Comic Relief makes the statement, while Epunda Slab, classic and dignified, carries the reading with a gaping c and rounded, lofty lowercase.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-fauna-one: Comic Relief draws its letters like bent wire, every stroke the same width and every bowl left open on one side. Fauna One, literary and dignified, gives lowercase most of the height and opens the e generously.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is traditional and refined, with a high-waisted lowercase. Its ruler-straight partner Comic Relief is bold and commanding, and the gap in lowercase height between them is what makes the two memorable.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads classic and editorial, with open-ended curves that sit comfortably under Comic Relief's uninterrupted, uniform line width. Because of its large x-height, Kadwa can go a touch smaller.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, its big entrances into curved letters and full-height lowercase bodies giving paragraphs real presence. Comic Relief's unvarying line leads, and Noticia Text follows quietly.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching capitals. Beside Comic Relief, whose bold strokes never vary and whose bowls stay open on one side, Piazzolla's lowercase and pried-open e feel carefully measured.
